# ADU Alliance
> Orange County's dedicated accessory dwelling unit (ADU) design-build general contractor network. We provide turnkey 3D architectural plans, structural engineering, 100% in-house municipal permitting across all 34 Orange County cities, and ground-up licensed construction.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- [Garage to ADU Conversions](https://adualliance.com/services/garage-conversion): Turnkey conversion of existing 2-car garages into permitted 1-bedroom or studio suites. Starting from $95,000 to $149,000; typical build timeline 10 to 14 weeks.
- [Detached ADU Construction](https://adualliance.com/services/detached-adu): Ground-up custom standalone backyard homes (350 to 1,200 sq ft). Starting from $149,000 to $245,000+.
- [Junior ADUs (JADU)](https://adualliance.com/services/junior-adu): Attached suites and interior conversions up to 500 sq ft within existing home envelopes.
- [ADU Plans & Architectural Design](https://adualliance.com/services/adu-design): Custom 3D plans, structural engineering calculations, and Title 24 energy compliance sets.
- [City Permitting & Approvals](https://adualliance.com/services/adu-permits): 100% in-house municipal plan check expediting across all 34 Orange County building departments.

## Key Facts & 2026 California Laws
- **Setback Rules**: California state law caps rear and side setbacks at a maximum of 4 feet for detached single-story ADUs up to 16-18 feet high.
- **Mandatory 60-Day Review**: Local Orange County building departments must review compliant ADU permit applications within 60 days.
- **HOA Protection**: Under Assembly Bill 670, Homeowners Associations cannot prohibit the construction of ADUs or JADUs on single-family lots.
- **Separate Condominium Sales (AB 1033)**: Allows local jurisdictions to authorize separate conveyance and sale of ADUs as condominiums.
- **Property Taxes (Prop 13)**: Adding an ADU does not trigger a full reassessment of the primary residence; only the newly added square footage is assessed.
